items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued November 4 at 4:44AM EST by NWS Charleston SC
items.description:
Patchy dense fog has developed across portions of the South Carolina
Lowcountry this morning. Visibilities could be limited to a quarter
of a mile at times. The fog should generally dissipate within an hour
or two after sunrise.
items.instruction:
Stay tuned to NOAA Weather Radio All Hazards, TV or your local news
source for the latest information from the National Weather Service.

If driving, slow down and leave extra distance ahead of you in case a
sudden stop is needed.
